readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, Monsieur Monnier asked everyone to show their watches.
Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when watches were shown.
The temple struck ten while Madame and Dr Vauthier played piquet.
A moment after Dr Vauthier came back, the hall clock struck eleven.

durations: A moment after Dr Vauthier came back, until the hall clock struck eleven (stated as 'a moment after he came back', no exact length).
whereabouts: Monsieur Monnier was found in his atelier (stated by Inspector Matthey).
Madame Monnier dined at the usual hour.
Félix dined at the house with Madame Monnier and Monsieur Monnier that evening.
Monsieur Girard was at dinner, where he quarrelled with Monsieur Monnier about the repeater.
Monsieur Monnier was with the others when the watches were shown at nine.
Madame Monnier and Dr Vauthier went into the salon after dinner.
Madame Monnier and Dr Vauthier played piquet.
Dr Vauthier went out to fetch his cigars during the game.
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano and played until Dr Vauthier came back.
Madame Monnier stopped playing when Dr Vauthier came in.
Dr Vauthier came back into the room.
